reviews.text: Fantastic. Great location & teachers. Only downside is parking
Glad to be here!. I love the welcoming atmosphere, kindness, and knowledge of staff. I also find encouragement in watching such a diverse group of yogis in all stages of the practice.
Soooo good. Modo always leaves me feeling better than I arrived. Without failure. I cannot rave highly enough about this place. So grateful it exists.
Impressed. This app has everything! The more I play with it the more I find! You can pre buy your drinks for your classes! And reserve equipment in advance. Can’t ask for much more
Love the studio. App could be better and often glitches.
Works perfectly.. Excellent work
Easy to use & helpful. Everything you’d want in a booking app. Super user-friendly. 💣
Efficient. One of the best scheduling apps I’ve ever used!
Yes yes yes!. Amazing app, better studio. A++++

ModoYogaLove.. I started attending classes after my beloved daughter Livi passed away, nearly 8 years ago.
I’ve found comfort in the warmth of the instructors & of course the heated room has 
been essential in my healing journey.💜
Easy to use. Best fitness app!
Love Moda Yoga!. Love this studio. Always clean and the instructors are awesome.

The best studio ever!. I’ve been with Modo yoga since they opened in NY. Before that I went to number of yoga studios in Ny and most of them were ok but not good enough. Modo is great! All teachers including staff always helpful and lovely. Go Modo!

Changed my life. I hate winter. After many years of fighting it, in the fall of 2019 l decided to try Modo to stay in touch with my body (that is, not be wrapped in fleece 24/7 from October through April) and soak up some warmth a couple times a week. Not being a consistent yogi (I’d go to a class now and then, mostly special events at breweries) and over 60, I was hesitant. What I discovered was a caring, supportive community of fabulous teachers and yogis and a total addiction. After only a couple of weeks, I found myself going daily, not just in cold weather but throughout the year. Unless I’m sick or out of town, I’m on my mat daily and I couldn’t be happier.
Easy. Very easy to use. Email notifications set up to remind you. Good app. Quick load time.

Modo Rocks. Modo Yoga is way more than just a place to take a yoga class. It is a caring community of open minded people coming together to better themselves, the people they encounter and where they live. Any level yogi can practice here comfortably. Hope to see you on your mat sometime soon.
Great app!. Easy to use!
How many Moda apps can there be.. It's so Yoga that studios by the same name and affiliation can agree on one app to use.
Great app and classes. The app works great for booking classes. Super easy and fast to use. Modo yoga has great classes and excellent instructors. I definitely recommend it.
Love Modo. Awesome smooth app.

Best Workout Best Vibe. The studio is relaxed and completely understated. It provides a positive, calm, environment. The clientele includes professional dancers and celebrities yet there is nothing intimidating about the studio or the workout. The workout is phenomenal. Be prepared to sweat:).
The Best. Great studio, great classes, great teachers. Taken in NY and LA and all consistently excellent. Plus very nice studio and great location. An oasis in the day.
Seamless!. Easy to book, cancel, and plan ahead for my week! Keeps me motivated and organized
Easy to book a class. The app makes extremely easy to book a class and cancel if you need to!

Hot Amazing Yoga. There’s so many hot yoga places around, but none of them are this place. Modo Yoga is simply the best. The lighting is calm, the studio is hot, the music is perfection, the atmosphere is so namaste that you don’t even want to leave. My body, mind & soul have never felt better. Mary Anne is an incredible instructor I enjoy all her classes. She is well trained in yoga and definitely knows what she’s doing and it shows. I love her and this place so much !
Great studio, terrible App. The app doesn’t sync with your calendar so I end up missing half my appointments

Can’t log in. I’ve tried multiple times to log in and reset my password, no email will send to my inbox for a reset. I’ve tried it over 20 times now… I have deleted the app and reinstalled it. Hoping that was the case, but also does not work. I have a lot of credits on my account that I cannot access, I would prefer not to make a new account.
Good. Good people, good teacher, good app!
Good yoga studio. Good epta advised

Surprisingly Good App. Most small business apps tend to be less than great, but this app surprised me!

It’s really easy to book classes, buy memberships and add classes to your phone’s calendar.

The app doesn’t try to do too much. It only gives you what you need.

Modo Yoga West-Island Montreal is great!. I really enjoy Modo Yoga West-Island. After a tough work day or before a weekend this place is a great place to unwind. I always come out feeling physically stronger and mentally more at peace after taking a class. There is always a workshop happening to pique my interest too. 👍🏻🙏🎉🙌🏻💪🏻

Amazing. This app is awesome. No glitches and super user friendly. Using the website on my phone was a bit of a pain, and the app has exceeded my expectations. 

The Modo studios in Winnipeg are the best in the city. The best instructors with the most soothing voices and clear instruction. The studios are clean and cozy. ❤️
Amazing!. App is easy to use. The classes are great and everyone is friendly. Great environment.
Makes Scheduling a Breeze. The app makes booking easier and it’s easy to see the upcoming schedule

Such an amazing app!. It makes scheduling my yoga practice as easy as possible!! seriously, it couldnt be easier. I love being able to see all the classes available well in advance and being able to book & plan a week in advance!
Hot yoga. It’s my second home for my pain and d stress ❤️

Love it. Great app. Easy purchasing, easy scheduling. Easy to view and plan out my week based on available classes. 
DEV NOTE: the new home screen widget isn’t displaying properly for me. It’s a blank square with no logo or colour or text.

I love my Modo studio!. I really love the Modo Yoga Sherwood Park studio. The instructors are top notch, the studio is lovely and clean, the changing room is well-equipped, and the community is very welcoming. I can’t imagine a better place to practice yoga.
Love it. Great for keeping track
Amazing. The best studio ever basically my second House an amazing community 🤩

Please bring back 30 days dashboard!. The old version of the app had a running count of how many classes you had completed in the last 30 days. This is a really good way to improve our own accountability. The current app only lists lifetime classes, while this is interesting information, it’s not useful in the day today of our practice. Could you please bring back the dashboard of classes completed in the last seven days and last 30 days?
Hot yoga. I love too do hot yoga all teachers are excellent love to go ❤️
Best hot yoga studios in town - Modo. Great environment, fabulous teachers, feel welcome and appreciated. Thank you Modo West Island ! You’re the best!

Good but.... The history of my classes did not carry over from the previous app, had nearly 600 completed classes and now shows 11! Also, please bring back the feature that allows us to see how many spaces are left in the class.
Good App. Earlier I wrote a review suggesting that enrolment t numbers should be shown. It appears that studies are able to determine whether numbers are shown. So not an issue with the app.
Dina Frolova. Would be great to have the option to see how many people signed for the class. As previous app had.
